blocks.text: Functional group interconversion (FGI) ka matlab aik functional group ko doosre mein badalna hai, jaisa kisi khaas compound ki synthesis ke liye zaroori ho. FGI target molecules tak raaste banane mein ahem kirdar ada karta hai: saada shuruati maadde FGIs ko bunyadi juzw bana kar zyada pecheeda targets mein badle ja sakte hain, aur FGI carbon dhaancha banane aur raasta chunne dono mein madad deta hai. Pichhle chapters mein aaye interconversions neeche khulasa hain.

blocks.alt: Nau dabbon ka naqsha: alkene CH2=CH2, halogenoalkane CH3CH2Br, amine CH3CH2NH2, aldehyde CH3CHO, alcohol CH3CH2OH, amide CH3CONH2, ester CH3COOC2H5, carboxylic acid CH3COOH aur acyl chloride CH3COCl, nishan wale teeron se jure: HBr; ethanol mein KOH; NH3; KOH(aq); PBr3; H3PO4 ke saath bhaap; garha H2SO4 aur garmi; tezaabi dichromate (distil ya reflux); NaBH4; LiAlH4; H+ ke saath ethanol; SOCl2; acyl chloride se amide tak NH3; amide se amine tak LiAlH4.
blocks.caption: Aliphatic compounds mein functional group interconversions (Figure 25.3 ke mutabiq asal naqsha).
blocks.long_description: Har teer Chapters 21 se 24 ka aik reaction hai. Teeron ke peeche chal kar aik khandan se doosre tak pohanchna dikhta hai: maslan ethene se ethanamide tak ethene -> ethanol -> ethanoic acid -> ethanoyl chloride -> ethanamide.

blocks.alt: Beech mein benzene, teer methylbenzene (CH3Cl, AlCl3), benzenesulphonic acid (SO3, H2SO4), nitrobenzene (HNO3, H2SO4) aur phenylethanone (CH3COCl, AlCl3) ki taraf. Methylbenzene se benzyl alcohol ((i) Cl2, roshni; (ii) KOH(aq)) aur benzoic acid (KMnO4, H2SO4); benzenesulphonic acid se phenol ((i) NaOH; (ii) HCl); nitrobenzene se phenylamine (Sn, HCl).
blocks.caption: Aromatic compounds mein functional group interconversions (Figure 25.4 ke mutabiq asal naqsha).
blocks.long_description: Electrophilic substitution benzene par naya group lagati hai; phir naya group badla ja sakta hai. Methyl groups COOH mein oxidise ya roshni mein chlorinate ho kar hydrolyse hote hain; sulphonic acid group OH se badalta hai; nitro group NH2 mein reduce hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Aldehydes aur ketones aasani se nucleophilic addition kyun karte hain?
blocks.explanation: C=O group polar hai, is liye carbonyl carbon delta+ hai aur nucleophiles ko kheenchta hai; is ka pi bond aasani se toot'ta hai; aur hamwar (trigonal) carbonyl carbon oopar ya neeche se hamle ke liye khula hai.

blocks.prompt: Carboxylic acid ko us ke anhydride mein kaise badla ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Do tezaab molecules se taqatwar dehydrating agent, jaise P4O10, ke saath garam kar ke paani nikalein: 2CH3COOH -> (CH3CO)2O + H2O; ya tezaab ko acyl chloride (SOCl2) mein badal kar sodium namak se react karayein: CH3COCl + CH3COONa -> (CH3CO)2O + NaCl.

items: FGI: aik functional group doosre mein.
Aliphatic aur aromatic FGI naqshe Chapters 20 se 24 ke reactions jorte.
